comment: V6 agentic-acceptance fixtures (Z15): the AG8 scripted-agent shape narrowed to the two-model acceptance fixture - MODEL_A (google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite) is cheap and abandons the complex tasks; MODEL_B (google/gemini-3.1-pro) is expensive and completes everything. Abandonment is per-task deterministic through mock_backend's completion_rate_by_task. The long-loop session carries a deliberately general mid-loop correction (the drift prompt the protection's decision-drift release and the Z5 cause split judge); the correction session's mid-loop note stays code-flavored, so the two sessions contrast drift vs hold.
